'''Assassination''' was a branch of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Bureau of Operations/Legends|Bureau of Operations]]. As assassination was seen as a legitimate means of removing key members of the opposition, Assassination personnel were embraced with the rest of Imperial Intelligence. Since the ban on the use of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]], Assassination carefully cultivated the image of Assassination's operations being the fair contest of hunter and prey. In reality, Assassination operatives made sure that they had every advantage they could muster and select those targets for which success was assured. Their success ratio was much higher than the theoretical one.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>

[[Sienar Intelligence Systems/Legends|Sienar Intelligence Systems]] sold their entire [[scarab droid]] line of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] to Assassination in an "under-the-table" deal once the design had been perfected. The branch deployed them against many "enemies of the Empire."<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
